who: Python developers and security-conscious teams who pip install third-party packages (including AI agents that install packages on their own) and need to know what an install script does before it touches a real machine.
agent_work: An LLM agent detonates a package archive in a fresh network-off Celesto microVM, records every file, process and network attempt made during install and import with in-guest audit hooks, inspects the guest, and writes a scored risk report.
proof_output: reports/detonations/<run_id>.json: a risk report with verdict, score, findings and evidence.
